full_page.content:
St. Felix Monastery R.R.8 Huntington, Indiana
August 9th, 1951 Blessed be God in all His designs.
God bless you Mrs. Pauline Leppich.
Many thanks for your kind favor of several months ago - duly rec'd and notes. Please pardon delayed acknowlegement ..
I surely sympathize with your little one who has eczema. I do not know how it came that only To-day I got to read your letter.
To sponge with diluted creclin is good for eczema. - say . a teaspoonful or more in a pint of water.
Enrollment in the Seraphic Mass Assoc'n too has brought wonder results. ...
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
